Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **A**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card, re-checked by the director on the two PRs): PR #18985 (card #17778, 22 files, head `e1978a0f`) and PR #18638 (card #15811, 59 files, head `70407326`) are both draft on base `d8b12fca`, both `needs:contract-review`, and both narrow `FieldSchema`'s `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`; 12 paths overlap (`expression.zod.ts`, `field.zod.ts`, the migration registry, six api-surface declarations, three reference pages); the runtime outcome for the triad is identical; each registers a different ADR-0087 id for the same surface. Before #18985 the `Predicate*` aliases had **zero** slot composers — a dead symbol #18985 revives as a carrier, leaving two public names for 「an expression that is really evaluated」.

## Ruling — A

- **#18985** (seat 3, card #17778): remove the triad-slot edits, the alias rebinding, its `field-rule-predicate-evaluated-slot-source-required` ledger entry and the overlapping api-surface / reference-page rows; keep the fault-semantics record (ADR-0136), the ADR-0089 addendum, the ADR-0058 D7 roster entry and the type-check DEBT fix. Its card #17778 (batch #119 item 3) ruled fault semantics, not the carrier symbol — nothing ruled is lost.
- **#18638** (card #15811, batch #122 item 2 「by identity on all 36 positions」) is the sole owner of the accept-set narrowing, one ADR-0087 id, and lands first; #18985 rebases after it.
- `PredicateSchema` / `PredicateInputSchema` stay as they are; ⛔ not narrowed, ⛔ not published narrowed. A later card may retire them as dead symbols on their own measurement.
- ⛔ **B** (narrow first, wide realigns, two ids cross-referenced) fixes two names and two ledger rows for one surface; ⛔ **C** (one merged PR) glues 81 files behind one review.

Four-facet reading: ① one composable type name for an evaluated expression; ② 36 positions refuse an empty / ast-only predicate for authors in one landing; ③ two synonymous legal names is the free-form trap an AI guesses between; ④ no new permanent public obligation.

## Execution

Graded here (the card arrived bare): `domain:spec`, `priority:p2`. `needs-user-decision` stripped; **closed not_planned** — the ruling executes on the two carrying cards (#17778: seat 3 rebases PR #18985 per the first bullet; #15811: PR #18638 proceeds to its at-tier review and the queue).
